Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ فِيمَا تَقْضِيْ وَتُقَدِّرُ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You to make, in what You decree and determine

Arabic text: مِنَ الْاَمْرِ الْمَحْتُومِ فِيْ الْاَمْرِ الْحَكِيمِ
Translation: From the inevitable matters in the wise command

Arabic text: مِنَ الْقَضَاءِ الَّذِيْ لَا يُرَدُّ وَلَا يُبَدَّلُ
Translation: From the decree which cannot be rejected nor changed

Arabic text: أَنْ تَكْتُبَنِيْ مِنْ حُجَّاجِ بَيْتِكَ الْحَرَامِ
Translation: That You write me among the pilgrims to Your Sacred House
And that You make in what You decree and determine

Arabic text: أَنْ تُطِيلَ عُمْرِيْ فِيْ خَيْرٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ
Translation: That You extend my life in goodness and well-being
And make me among those through whom You give victory to Your religion
And do not replace me with someone else
